entry.title: Soie 0.1.1
entry.content:
Added

  • about:settings, the settings page of xsoie and wsoie, kept in ~/.config/soie/settings.
  • The fronts follow the desktop's dark or light theme.
  • The logo, an S of three silk threads: icons, window icon, favicon.

Changed

  • Checkboxes and radio buttons are drawn as browsers draw them, placeholders are faded.
  • SVG curves are cut finer when they are large on screen.

Fixed

  • history.pushState() and replaceState() keep the page's origin: in 0.1.0 a page could take another site's address (security).
  • Flex column items are measured at their laid out width, max-width included.
  • The auto width of a replaced box with a height follows its ratio.

entry.title: Soie 0.1.0
entry.content:
Added

  • First public release.
  • libsoie: HTML parsed as the WHATWG says (html5lib tree tests), the CSS cascade (css-parsing-tests), blocks, inline text, tables, flexbox, grid and SVG, painted with FreeType and HarfBuzz; incremental restyle and layout.
  • Extensions: cookies, content blocking, WebP, JavaScript with QuickJS (DOM, fetch, workers), audio and video with FFmpeg and Media Source Extensions.
  • Browsers: xsoie (X11), wsoie (Wayland), SoieView (GTK 3 widget).
  • soie-render, a headless renderer for tests and screenshots.
